subject: ventures/patio-door-bid-calculator
professional: a window-and-door installation contractor who bids sliding and multi-panel patio-door replacements; first checks: does the price move with panels, frame, glass, install method and access on a returning visit, are crew-hours and the sill pan counted once, is the walk-away the cost, and does a blank box ever price as zero

evidence.correctness: Scored on the code as it stood at the start of this session (after PR #17050). Three bids recomputed by hand and matched to the cent with node (scratch scripts cases.mjs / cases2.mjs run against calc.mjs): the page-default 6-ft vinyl retrofit 7.4 h, $2,770.12, walk-away $1,883.68; the 16-ft 4-panel fiberglass impact new-con balcony with transom, trim, sill pan and tear-out 30.4125 h, cost $15,492.02, price $22,782.38; an own case (8-ft wood-clad triple new-con, $52 wage, 28% burden, 12% OH, 30% margin, $85 permit, proposed $9,000) 13.675 h, cost $6,946.61, price $9,923.72, margin at $9,000 22.82%. The restore fix holds: restoredOverrides on a saved page-default form marks no config-kit field edited, so a changed select moves the price again. Still wrong at the start: calculateBid({...defaults, hourlyWage: ''}) priced $1,859.41 (labor $0) and unitCost '' priced $857.77 (no door), no error. Capped at 2 for that.
evidence.completeness: README features checked end to end: presets, five kits, extras, proposed-price check, summary copy, save/restore (now correct), share link, printable proposal; 144 tests green. The proposal, share and usage modules are exercised by their own suites.
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' 144/144 at start. Mutants: restoredOverrides comparison flipped caught; addSillPan guard removed caught; the page's restore line forced to mark every field edited (the exact 2026-11-17 high defect) SURVIVED every test. After this PR's page test it is caught.
evidence.craft: calc.mjs, index.html (applyKit, applyValues, readInput, update) and vs-a-flat-installed-price.html read. applyKit carried a dead `ids` branch; the money formatter is duplicated between calc.mjs and the page; the blank-input path was unhandled in the engine.
evidence.claims: vs-a-flat comparison table now says 'Bid at a 32% margin' and 'Under the bid by' (closed), but its prose and FAQ (and FAQ JSON-LD) still said the tool 'returns a walk-away price' for the marked-up price. The page and guide described new-construction wrap hours as including the sill pan while the presets also add the sill-pan line. 'Effective hourly rate' and 'billing $X/h of labor' divide the whole price, door included, by hours. README listed 4 of 7 counted events. Disclaimer present.
evidence.fitness: A contractor can price a single opening end to end; a two- or three-person set had to be entered as multiplied hours with no word on the page that the hours are crew-hours priced at one wage, and a cleared box priced silently.
evidence.domain: Against installer practice: new-construction (nail-fin) installs per AAMA 2400-style procedure tear back to the rough opening, install a sill pan, then flash and integrate with the WRB. The tool's wrap hours (2.8 h) were described as including the pan while the pan line (1.5 h, $165) was added again on the new-con presets, double-counting it. Margin-on-price and loaded wage are standard.

verdict: Below the bar at the start of this session, but much closer than on 2026-11-17. PR #17050 closed the high defect that froze the price on return visits and relabelled the comparison table; the engine reproduces three hand-computed bids to the cent, including an independent wood-clad new-construction case. What still held it at 2 on correctness, claims and verification: a blank or comma-typed box priced as zero, the comparison prose still called the bid the walk-away, new-construction copy counted the sill pan twice, and the restore fix had no test (its mutant survived). PR #18138 fixes all four plus the rate label, the README event list and a dead branch, and adds the tests that catch them; a mixed-wage crew and the duplicated formatter remain. Scores here are before that PR; a later round re-audits.
